questions.question: The average height of some students in a group is 156 cm. If 5 students of average height 160 cm join the group, then the average height of all the students in the group increases by 0.8 cm. What is the number of students in the group, initially?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average height of some students = 156cm

**Formula:**

Average = (Sum of terms)/(Number of terms)

**Calculation:**

Let number of students in a group be N.

Total height of N students = N × 156 = 156N cm

Total height of 5 students = 5 × 160 = 800 cm

Total height of (N + 5) students = 800 + 156N

New average = 156 + 0.8 = 156.8 cm

New number of students = N + 5

Total height of (N + 5) students = (N + 5) × 156.8 = (156.8N + 784) cm

Then,

⇒ 156.8N + 784 = 800 + 156N

⇒ N = 20

**∴ Number of students = N = 20**

questions.question: A trader bought two articles for Rs.490. He sold one at a loss of 20% and the other at a profit of 16%. If the selling price of both articles is same, then the cost price (in Rs.) of the article sold at 20% loss is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of articles = Rs.490

Loss % = 20%

Profit % = 16%

**Formula:**

Loss % = (CP - SP)/CP × 100

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let cost price of one article be Rs.a and cost price of two article be Rs.(490 - a).

Selling price of one article = a × 80/100 = Rs.4a/5

Selling price of other article = (490 - a) × 116/100 = Rs.(568.4 - 29a/25)

Then,

⇒ 4a/5 = 568.4 - 29a/25

⇒ 49a/25 = 568.4

⇒ a = 290

**∴ Cost price of article which sold at loss of 20% is Rs.290.**

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

 Put x = 7, y = 1

x2 + 4y2 = 53 and x - 2y = 5

= 5 × (53 + 2 × 7)

**∴ x3 - 8y3 = 335**

If two Managers are engaged to supervise the workers, with daily wages ranging between Rs.700 and Rs.800, then what will be the average daily wage (nearest to an Rs.) of all members of staff of the factory?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

There will be a total of 41 members in the factory = 39 workers + 2 managers

Daily wages of the managers ranges between 700 and 800, it would be calculated on the basis of 750.

Similarly, the calculation would be done according to the midpoints (for eg. if 5 employees have their salaries between 200 to 300, it will be solved as 5 × 250)

Total daily wages of all members of staff of the factory = 250 × 5 + 350 × 9 + 450 × 12 + 550 × 11 + 650 × 2 + 750 × 2 = Rs.18650

Total number of workers = 5 + 9 + 12 + 11 + 2 + 2 = 41

**∴ the average daily wage of all members of staff of the factory = 18650/41 = 454.8 ≈ Rs.455**

questions.question: The area of a square shaped field is 1764 m². The breadth of a rectangular park is (1)/(3)rd the side of the square field and its length is two times its breadth. What is the cost (in Rs.) of levelling the park at Rs.15 per m²?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of a square field = 1764 sq.m

**Formula:**

Area of square = side²

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

**Calculation:**

Area of square field = 1764

Side of square field = √1764 = 42 m

Breadth of rectangular field = 42 × 1/3 = 14 m

Length of rectangular field = 14 × 2 = 28 m

Area of rectangular field = 14 × 28 = 392 sq.m

**So, Cost of levelling park = 15 × 392 = Rs.5880**

questions.question: If p - 2q = 3 and pq = 5, then what is the value of (p³ - 8q³)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

p - 2q = 3 and pq = 5

**Formula:**

⇒ (a³ - b³) = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

⇒ (a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ (p - 2q)² = p² + 4q² - 4pq

⇒ 9 = p² + 4q² - 4 × 5

⇒ p² + 4q² = 29

(p³ - (2q)³) = (p - 2q)(p² + 2pq + 4q²)

= 3 × (29 + 2 × 5)

= 117

**∴ (p3 - 8q3) = 117**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**(p - 2q)³ = p³ - 8q³ - 3 × p × 2q(p - 2q)

⇒ 3³ = p³ - 8q³ - 6 × 5 × 3

⇒ p3 - 8q3 = 90 + 27 

⇒ p3 - 8q3 = 117

∴ (p3 - 8q3) = 117

questions.question: ΔABC is incribed in a circle with center O, such that ∠ACB = 115°, O is joined to A. What is the measure of ∠OAB?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ ACB = 115

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce789db896f06a5046a2de0d89b37d99ee2f9d0239ef220f422d1bc32335f60a.png] 

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of a circle.

⇒ External ∠AOB = 2∠ ACB

⇒ External ∠AOB = 115° × 2 = 230°

⇒ Internal ∠AOB = 360° - 230° = 130°

In ΔABO, AO = BO = Radii of circle.

⇒ ∠BAO = ∠ ABO 

In ΔABO,

⇒ ∠BAO + ∠ ABO + ∠ AOB = 180°

⇒ ∠BAO = 1/2 × (180° - 130°) = 25°

**∴ ∠OAB = 25°.**

questions.question: Samir and Puneet can complete the same work in 10 days and 15 days respectively. The work was assigned for Rs.4500. After working together for 3 days Samir and Puneet involved Ashok. The work was completed in total 5 days. What amount (in Rs.) was paid to Ashok?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Samir's 1 day's work = 1/10

Puneet's 1 day's work = 1/15

**Calculation:**

(Samir + Puneet)'s 1 day's work = 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6

(Samir + Puneet)'s 3 days work = 3 × 1/6 = 1/2

Remaining work after 3 days = 1 - 1/2 = 1/2

Remaining work completed in 2 days.

(Samir + Puneet + Ashok)'s 1 day's work = 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4

Ashok's 1 day's work = 1/4 - 1/6 = 1/12

Ratio of work done = 5/10 : 5/15 : 2/12

= 1/2 : 1/3 : 1/6

= 3 : 2 : 1

**∴ Ashok's share = 1/6 × 4500 = Rs.750**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Samir and Puneet can complete the same work in 10 days and 15 days respectively

Total work = LCM(10, 15) = 30 units 

Efficiency of Samir = 30/10 = 3 units

Efficiency of Puneet = 30/15 = 2 units 

According to the question,

Samir and Puneet worked for (3 + 2) = 5 days 

Work done by Samir and Puneet in 5 days = 5 × 5 = 25 units 

Remaining 5 units of work is done by Ashok in 2 days

Efficiency of Ashok = 5/2 = 2.5 units 

Total amount = Rs. 4500

Amount given for 1 unit of work = 4500/30 = 150

Amount given to Ashok = 150 × 5 = Rs. 750

A boat goes 27 km upstream and 33 km downstream in 6 hours. In the same time it can go 36 km upstream and 22 km downstream. How much time will it take to go 36 km upstream and 44 km downstream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

27km upstream and 33km downstream = 6 hours

36km upstream and 22km downstream = 6 hours

**Formula:**

Speed of boat = a kmph and Speed of stream = b kmph

Speed of upstream = (a - b) kmph

Speed of downstream = (a + b) kmph

**Calculation:**

⇒ 33/(a + b) + 27/(a - b) = 6

⇒ 22/(a + b) + 36/(a - b) = 6

Then,

⇒ 33/(a + b) + 27/(a - b) = 22/(a + b) + 36/(a - b)

⇒ 11/(a + b) = 9/(a - b) 

⇒ 11a - 11b = 9a + 9b

⇒ 2a = 20b

⇒ a = 10b

Then,

⇒ 33/(10b + b) + 27/(10b - b) = 6

⇒ 3/b + 3/b = 6

⇒ b = 1

⇒ a = 10

Speed downstream = 10 + 1 = 11 kmph

Speed upstream = 10 - 1 = 9 kmph

Then,

⇒ ? = 44/11 + 36/9 

⇒ ? = 4 + 4

⇒ ? = 8

**∴ it will take 8 hours to go 36 km upstream and 44 km downstream.**

Perpendicular drawn from centre of circle to chord which bisects the chord.

⇒ OB² = PB² + OP²

⇒ OB² = 6² + OP²

Similarly, for chord CD.

CQ = QD = 18/2 = 9cm

In right angled triangle QDC,

⇒ OD² = QD² + OQ²

⇒ OD² = 9² + OQ²

Then,

⇒ OP = OQ + QP

questions.question: Fourth proportion to 12, 18 and 6 is same as the third proportion to k and 6. What is the value of k?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers = 12, 18 and 6

**Calculation:**

Forth proportion 12, 18 and 6 is n,

⇒ 12 : 18 :: 6 : n

⇒ 12/18 = 6/n

⇒ n = 9

Then,

Third proportional to k and 6 is 9.

⇒ k : 6 = 6 : 9

⇒ 9k = 36

⇒ k = 4

**∴ Value of k is 4.**

questions.question: In ΔABC, D is the mid-point of side AC and E is a point on side AB such that EC bisects BD at F. If AE = 30 cm, then the length of EB is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AE = 30cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dab9cae07ce0c61580ea1de10b7b831aa598ff93d7442352a85e17b8077b324.png] 

Draw a line parallel to EC from point D on side AE at G.

Now, in ΔAEC, DG || EC

⇒ AG/GE = AD/DC

As D is the mid-point of side AC

AD = DC

⇒ AG/GE = 1

⇒ AG = GE

According to the question, AE = AG + GE

⇒ AG = GE = 30/2 = 15 ----(01)

Now, in ΔBDG, GD || EF

⇒ GE/EB = DF/FB

As EC bisects BD at F

DF = FB

⇒ GE/EB = 1

⇒ GE = EB ----(02)

From (01) and (02)

EB = GE = 15 cm

**∴ The length of EB is 15 cm.**

questions.question: Find the difference between squares of the greatest value and the smallest value of P if the number 5306P2 is divisible by 3.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 5306P2

**Concept:**

Divisibility test of 3 = Number should be divisible by 3 when sum of digits of number should be divisible by 3.

**Calculation:**

Number = 5306P2

Sum of terms = (5 + 3 + 0 + 6 + P + 2) = 16 + P

Smallest value of P should be divisible by 3 = 16 + 2 = 18

Greatest value of P should be divisible by 3 = 16 + 8 = 24

**∴ Required difference = 8² - 2² = 60**

questions.question: If a number is first increased by 15%, then reduced by 15%, it results in 782. If the same number is first reduced by 25%, then increased by 25% and again reduced by 20%, then what will be the resulting number?
questions.solution:

A number is first increased by 15%, then reduced by 15%.

Number became 782.

The same number is first reduced by 25%, then increased by 25%, and again reduced by 20%.

**Calculation:**

Let the number of N.

Number after increased by 15% = N × 115/100 = 23N/20

Number after decreased by 15% = (23N/20) × (85/100) = 1955N / 2000

= 391N/400

Then,

⇒ 391N/400 = 782

⇒ N = 800

New number after reduced by 25% = 800 × 75/100 = **600**

New number after increased by 25% = **600 **× 125/100 = **750**</p&g
